supersedes.reason: Version 5 reached the pinned vLLM server with unrestricted one-token branch requests, but its frozen temperature of 4.0 exceeded vLLM's inclusive maximum of 2.0 and every branch request was rejected before generation.

scope.purpose: Prove that the 4B LoRA Stage C path completes one exact-snapshot ReDCO update while preserving an unrestricted one-token behavior distribution from inference through training.

behavior_action_policy.representation: one model token from the complete behavior-policy support

decoder.temperature_constraint: locally validated as greater than zero and less than or equal to the pinned vLLM maximum of 2.0

behavior_action_policy.invalid_action_semantics: Any token whose exact decoded text is not an allowed action digit is executed without repair or resampling and receives the probe's deterministic failure reward.
behavior_action_policy.same_distribution_contract: Original and three alternatives use the same checkpoint, prompt, temperature, top-p, tool state, maximum length, and unrestricted token support; only structural seed and cache salt vary.
behavior_action_policy.trainer_contract: Prime resolves each sample temperature from the trace's recorded agent sampling configuration, falling back to the environment temperature only when no trace agent exists.

hardware.spot_policy: reject the resource if provisioning identifies it as spot or preemptible
prohibited: a second simultaneous Stage C pod

resource_policy.stop_if_v2_lifecycle_error_recurs: ValueError: clean Stage C permits one collected group per snapshot

mandatory: all frozen source hashes match locally and remotely
exactly two complete effective episodes and ten effective traces are serialized
all collected traces form complete five-trace episodes under policy version zero
each effective episode contains one context and branch indices zero through three
each effective branch records exactly one sampled token, temperature 2.0, a distinct structural seed, and a distinct cache salt
invalid displayed actions, if any, are retained with null canonical action and their true deterministic failure reward
at least one effective episode has nonconstant counterfactual branch rewards
every target is committed before action sampling
all effective branch records report exact sliced/full reward equivalence
the optimizer gradient norm is finite and positive
a non-empty LoRA adapter is saved
decision_rule.failure: sync all artifacts, emit a signed structured failure, terminate compute, and do not start a learning arm
